finalText:
It builds clean now, 0 errors.

Two spots hadn't caught up with the new bundler's option shape. `src/core/options.js` was still reading `options.retries`, but the bundler now sends `retryCount` — that undefined was crashing on `.toFixed()`. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` rejected anything that wasn't strictly `true` or `false`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` — now that's treated as backoff off, same as the old default.

The rest was just noise: 8 deprecation warnings from the bump itself (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, and a few others), unrelated to the crash.
